items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Remember who was, uh, Mike Vidi in those bands more than anyone? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah. We speak of different fellas.

ctx.x: Well, we have some... Tender drugs. Let's see. We have three cornet players. Clionettes. Two drums. Two trombones. A ballastone and a bass.
Remember who was, uh, Mike Vidi in those bands more than anyone?
